text:
olga: Heads-up — saw a ~4x spike in fncall validation failures on /chat/invoke starting ~10:03 PST. Dashboard shows a big chunk under 'validation_errors' but no breakdown.
kevin: Any region/variant skew?
olga: Mostly us-west-2, route_id=router-v2, model-variant=short-ctx-degen. Billing looks weird: some rejects still counted as billable in reports.
nashley: Can you paste a raw log sample?
olga: sure:
2026-03-23T17:03:12Z INFO invoke.request id=abc123 route=router-v2 region=us-west-2 model=short-ctx-degen status=validation_reject reason="output_shape_mismatch" schema=/schemas/chat_tool_v2.json
2026-03-23T17:03:12Z WARN fncall.validator id=abc123 stage=post-invoke details="expected object, got array"
kevin: Validator emits a typed reason but console only shows generic 'validation error'?
diana: Correct — console heatmap lacks a `validation_reason` dimension, and error buckets lack variant granularity. Makes triage and quota accounting painful.
sre-bot: alert: validation_error_rate for /chat/invoke crossed 3% (threshold 1.5%) in us-west-2 at 17:03:20Z
nashley: Telemetry with `validation_reason` + `route_variant` would let us filter dashboards, attribute to quota buckets, and show tooltips. Also helps automated rollback decisions.
kevin: Proposal: add two fields to invoke error events: `validation_reason` (enum aligned to validator taxonomy) and `validator_version`. Fields nullable to limit initial payload. Backfill via a sampled job later.
olga: +1. Use stable enum keys (no free-form text) like `output_shape_mismatch`, `missing_required_field`, `json_parse_error`. Must avoid PII in reason text.
diana: Finance says some rejects still bill because billing marks tokens on arrival, not post-validation. If we attach `validation_outcome` to the final delivery event, we can exclude hard rejects from billing reports after a migration window.
nashley: UX wants console filters for "validation_reason" and an inline legend on the invoke timeline. Also display one redacted failing example per bucket for engineers.
kevin: Implementation sketch: runtime already sets validator result in request context. Changes needed: (1) event emitter: add the fields to kafka invoke_result messages, (2) metrics ingestion: map enum to a tag, (3) console index: add new column and filters.
sre-bot: Warning: adding high-cardinality tags increases index size. Recommend sampling at 5% for the first 48h.
olga: Agree on sampling, but propose dynamic override: route 100% capture for traffic windows where `error_rate > 2%` until human ACK. That helps anomaly triage.
diana: Timeline: ship runtime+emitter (kevin/ashley) -> console schema update (ashley) -> billing backfill plan (diana/finops). Canary?
kevin: Canary plan: enable full reason tagging for 10% traffic on router-v2-canary for 24h, track cardinality & payload size. Also add `soft_validate=true` toggle where we attach reasons but do not reject, to gather telemetry without impacting customers.
nashley: UX will surface soft_validate traffic separately and add a checkbox "Include soft validation samples" for the heatmap.
diana: Billing: rule to mark non-billable: `validation_outcome == hard_reject` AND `validator_version >= v1.4.0`. We'll coordinate a migration window with finance.
kevin: Minimal kafka event prototype: { event_type: invoke_result, route_id: router-v2, validation_outcome: hard_reject|soft_reject|pass, validation_reason: output_shape_mismatch|missing_required_field|json_parse_error, validator_version: v1.4.2, route_variant: short-ctx-degen, region: us-west-2 }
olga: Also expose `route_variant` and `region` as indexed tags for easier joins.
console-bot: NOTE: console index migration estimated +2.4GB for 30 days at current sampling.
sre-bot: Ops checklist: alert update, pager runbook addendum, sampling override implementation, cardinality dashboards.
kevin: Action items: (1) runtime/emitter PR by EOD tomorrow (owner: kevin), (2) canary config + sampling override (owner: olga), (3) console index PR and mocks (owner: ashley), (4) billing rule draft (owner: diana).
nashley: I'll prep console mocks and UX copy today.
diana: I'll loop in finance after we finalize the taxonomy.
olga: I'll run a grep to collect recent failing examples and attach redacted snippets to the ticket.
kevin: Tests: add unit tests that validate `validation_reason` is an enum and disallow free text.
nashley: Sync in 11am triage. If anyone sees another spike, ping #incidents. :thumbsup:
olga: thanks all.
